header.name: AITOR IZURRATEGUI
header.title: PRODUCT ENGINEER | UNITY | AI FIRST DEVELOPER
header.summary: Product engineer with 5+ years building Unity/VR experiences, currently shipping Meta-funded Mixed Reality sports apps for Meta Quest. AI-first developer leveraging agentic tools (Claude Code) to move fast across game, web and tooling projects, with strong UX and systems design instincts.

bullets: Developed Unity/OpenXR features for Xtadium, a free Meta-funded Mixed Reality sports app for Meta Quest featured as a top Meta MR app, streaming NBA, UFC, EuroLeague and NASCAR content up to 8K 180°/360°.
Built a UI component system that let the design team assemble screens directly in Unity, fully removing engineering from UI layout work.
Shipped a full localization system (English, Spanish, German) and an onboarding/tutorial framework usable directly by designers.
Developed a real-time interactive 3D tabletop for NASCAR broadcasts rendering 100+ cars synced to live and VOD telemetry, used across 3 live events.
Built the reusable spin-off system powering derivative apps (Xtadium Music, CultVRe) from a shared codebase.
Optimized rendering and data pipelines to sustain a stable 90 FPS on Meta Quest.

Contributed to the continuous refactor of core app systems (UI, navigation, notifications, backend data integration) and the Built-in to URP render pipeline migration, paying down technical debt on a live production app without slowing feature delivery.
Programmed, tested and optimized gameplay mechanics and in-game environments in unannounced RPG mobile transmedia title in Unity URP.
Helped design and document gameplay mechanics, UI, and general game experience for an unannounced RPG mobile transmedia title.
Coordinated 3D and 2D art teams using an agile workflow to create and implement assets in-engine, following design documentation.
Developed a dashboard to balance and manage the mobile game “ZPLN,” connecting to a Google Firebase backend using Angular and TypeScript.
Designed and implemented an early multiplayer testing mode for the mobile video game “ZPLN” using a Firebase backend.
Implemented game mechanics and UI for a serious game focused on teaching recent history to teenagers in a classroom setting.
Assisted in the development of a truck checking simulator for a company that issues truck driving licenses in the United States.
Assisted in the development of a runner-type video game for a Spanish company.
